newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Music to see rise in group net profit -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Sony Music to see rise in group net profit -- paper.

text.p: Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc is expected to have a nearly 40 percent rise in its consolidated net profit in the year ending on March 31, a business daily said on Thursday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the company's consolidated net profit was expected reach about 14 billion yen in the current business year thanks mainly to firm earnings of its subsidiary Sony Computer Entertainment Inc (SCE).
SCE's earnings have been buoyed by brisk sales of its game console PlayStation and game software, the paper said.
Sony Music Entertainment holds a 50 percent stake in SCE.
A spokeswoman for Sony Music Entertainment declined to comment on the report.
